_accepted: STOP A, 2026-09-01. Machine-readable companion to 02_tolerances.md; the prose record is authoritative for the rules the harness does not take as numbers (quarantine classes, empty-collection PASS, rerun and circuit-breaker budgets).
_full_diff_row_threshold: Every collection is under this, so all 13 get a full keyed diff rather than a sample: the largest root is CUSTOMER_MASTER at 25,000. INVOICE_LINE's 149,963 embedded elements are graded in full regardless, since embeds are graded per element and not sampled.
_sample_size: Unused at the current scale; kept so a production-sized rerun is a parameter change and not a tolerance amendment.
_zero_tolerance: Counts and values are exact. NUMBER(p,s) maps to Decimal128 and never to double, so there is no float drift to absorb.
_source_concurrency: STOP A source-load cap. The harness runs serially; the cap across concurrent units is enforced by the extract lease in 04_progress.md.
